Page number 53 at top right. Signature "d 3" at the foot centre.

main_text.p: Prima persona plurali desinente in Notio. ὡν, deest prima dualis, & si tertia pluralis finit in ι uel αι, tunc secunda & tertia duales similes sunt, aliâs dissimiles.
Item personis tertijs in ι uel ε finitis ν additur proxime uocali sequente, τύπτω σιν ἀνδρες, ἔτυπτεν ἀνήρ.
main_text.head: Variant Dialecti.
main_text.p: Dorice pro τύπτεις τύπτῃ, τύπτες τύπτε. Dialecti.

page.notes: Greek paradigm columns are reproduced as printed; some accents and breathings in the scan are doubtful. Marginal notes "Verbera ui." and "Verbera bo." are placed at the right beside their rows.
